name: Ludo Race
hook: Roll, race your tokens home, knock rivals back.
how: Roll the die and hop a token that many squares round the board; a 6 brings a new token out of the yard. Land on a rival and it goes back to start. Get all four home first to win. Bots play the empty colors.
controls: Click or tap to roll, then click or tap a glowing token (keys: Space to roll, 1–4 to pick)
uses: The host's browser rolls the die and checks every move; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
Bots play every empty color, so you can play alone, and a friend who joins takes over a bot's color mid-game.
Everyone sees the same rolls and hops; the game carries on if someone reloads while another player stays.
Most wins, shown after every game.
ideas: Add a boost square that jumps you 3 ahead
Make the tokens little racing cars
Let players chat with emoji during the game
